description:
Independent spaces per monitor, Overview and dynamic tiling for Windows

Standard Windows virtual desktops switch every monitor at the same time. WinSpaces gives each
display its own independent set of spaces (1-9), a live GPU-accelerated Overview overlay with
window thumbnails and drag-and-drop relocation, and optional Hyprland-style dynamic tiling.
Single small native Win32 binary written in Rust; installs per user without administrator rights.
